facts.fact: 十二点一刻起顾客开始来到 Turbo Putt：Jules 发放高尔夫球、记分卡和推杆，卖冰淇淋和 Snickers，还偷听那些 skeevy pastors 和 dumb NASCAR dads 的闲话。
facts.anchor: By twelve-fifteen, customers had started to arrive. Jules handed out golf balls and scorecards and putters. They sold ice cream and Snickers.

facts.fact: 上一晚 Jules 曾冲 Bethany 喊、叫她永远别再回来；到下午他们已承认想念她，盼着 Bethany 当天回到 Turbo Putt 把关系理顺。
facts.anchor: They’d shouted at her, told her to never come back.

facts.fact: 黄昏后 Jules 关上大金属格栅，穿过公路去 Wendy’s 买每周三的例行晚餐，独自在棚屋里吃。
facts.anchor: After dusk, Jules closed up the grate then walked across the highway to get their usual Wednesday dinner from Wendy’s.

facts.fact: 夜里有人敲大金属格栅：Jules 喊 “Hello?” “Bethany?” 却无人应答，打开格栅向迷你高尔夫球场的黑暗里望也空无一人；他们认定是高中橄榄球队的孩子又来捣乱。
facts.anchor: “Hello?” they called. “Bethany?” But there was no answer from the other side of the window.

facts.fact: Jules 翻遍毒品 stash 和电脑用品找手枪——那把专为此刻从 Walmart 买来的枪——却发现枪不见了。
facts.anchor: They’d bought it from Walmart for exactly this moment. But now it was nowhere to be found.

facts.fact: 棚屋门被撞离铰链，两名戴 ski mask 的男人冲进来；Jules 往格栅窗爬逃时被抓住双脚拖回，身体摔进撒了一地的高尔夫球堆，被拖出棚屋按进夜色。
facts.anchor: And then the door to the shed came off its hinges and two men in ski masks rushed inside.

facts.fact: Jules 被按在第十八洞的仿 Astroturf 上（就在那个通向地下的洞口前）；随后第三个戴 ski mask 的男人从黑暗中走出、跪到他们面前摘下面罩——那是 Jules 见过很多次、却从未当面见过的脸。
facts.anchor: They pinned Jules down on the imitation Astroturf of hole eighteen, right near the green, right in front of that hole that led underground.

facts.fact: 摘下面罩的是 David Sawyer；他说 “I heard a rumor you’ve been looking for me”，Jules Estrada 随即停止挣扎。
facts.anchor: “I heard a rumor you’ve been looking for me,” David Sawyer told them, and Jules Estrada stopped struggling.
